beats.say: No air at all for eighteen minutes, and it was fine.
Deep underground in East Africa, it digs tunnels.
The naked mole rat. Pink, wrinkly, and almost blind.
Scientists took away all of its oxygen.
Its body switched to burning a different sugar.
Eighteen minutes later, it woke up, unharmed.
And its colony has just one queen, like bees.
A mouse lives about two years. This one lives over thirty.
